body.statement: For every \(S\in\mathcal P_k\), \(\overline W(S)=\max_{\pi\in\mathcal F}R_{\pi}(S)=\max_{\pi\in\mathcal F}\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}q_x\min(\{1\}\cup\{d_{\pi xc}:c\in S\})\), and the supremum defining \(\overline W(S)\) is attained by two observationally indistinguishable fixed finite-population response schedules. Consequently \(D^{\star}\) is rational and attained.
body.justification: This is the field-level kernel: two observationally indistinguishable finite-population response schedules eliminate the causal response adversary and yield an exact prospective width before any outcomes are observed.
body.gap: AnthonyGoyalGuptaNagarajan2010 already supplies the robust scenario nearest-facility skeleton, and MontielOleaPrallonQiuStoyeSun2025 supplies a causal k-median reduction for external-validity regret. The new claim is instead the derivation of the action- and score-specific costs as the exact sharp diameter of reusable causal policy values.
body.consumer: Trial designers can evaluate every candidate panel without simulating outcomes or solving an inner shape-constrained program.
